title: Q-FLEETMAP-seed: ultrastable/seed is not equal to its source (59 file(s) differ, 66 missing, 12 only in the copy)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** fleetmap --drift --apply (daily in tenant-sync.yml)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe seed
**Prediction:** fleet_map_drifted_repos <= 0 within 168 h
**Status:** open

ultrastable/seed is a copy and is not equal to its source (FLEET-MAP-1): 59 file(s) differ, 66 missing, 12 only in the copy.

- differ: .github/copilot-instructions.md, .github/workflows/bootstrap.yml, .github/workflows/branch-cleanup.yml, .github/workflows/funding-maintenance.yml, .github/workflows/improve.yml, .github/workflows/memory-fresh.yml, .github/workflows/org-init.yml, .github/workflows/org-profile-probe.yml, .github/workflows/outreach.yml, .github/workflows/redteam.yml, AGENTS.md, CITATION.cff ...
- missing: .devcontainer/devcontainer.json, .editorconfig, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/start.yml, .github/dependabot.yml, .ultrastable/github.json, SYSTEM.md, autonomy/managers.json, autonomy/schemas/balance.schema.json, autonomy/schemas/catalog.json, autonomy/schemas/cost-budgets.schema.json, autonomy/schemas/criticality.schema.json ...
- extra: .github/workflows/balance.yml, doctrine/balance.json, doctrine/humanvoice.json, doctrine/system.json, doctrine/verification.json, scripts/humanvoice.py, scripts/verify.py, scripts/verify_spend.mjs, tests/test_balance.py, tests/test_verify.py, worker/src/stepplan.js, worker/test/stepplan.test.js

Fix the sync named in doctrine/fleet-map.json for this repository (never copy by hand), then the same reading closes this item.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe seed
